findings.title: Explicit null policy is treated as missing
findings.description: Task 1.3 uses `data.get("policy", None)` and defaults an absent value to `OPEN`. This cannot distinguish an omitted key from `policy: null`, although the slice requires every present value to be a string. Check key presence separately and add a null-value rejection test.

findings.title: Round-trip test does not verify the full config
findings.description: Task 1.4 asserts only that the policy matches after reload. Success criterion 5 requires a plain-string policy and an equal `ServerConfig`. Assert the parsed YAML value is a string and compare the reloaded config with the original.

findings.title: Manual walkthrough can leave the wrong shipped default
findings.description: Step 8 permits restoring `config/test.yaml` to any policy, despite success criterion 12 requiring `wrap`. Require restoration to `wrap` and verify it after the walkthrough.

findings.title: Commit markers use checkbox syntax
findings.description: All five commit instructions are checkbox items written as `**Commit:**`. Commit markers must instead be plain lines using `**Commit**:`. Their placement after tested groups is otherwise appropriate.

findings.title: Reflect edge-exact behavior lacks a test
findings.description: The slice calls for edge-exact coverage, but the reflect cases cover inside and crossed edges, not positions exactly at an edge. Add a case proving that an exact boundary position and its velocity remain unchanged until the position crosses the boundary.

findings.title: Task breakdown is overweight for the slice
findings.description: Merge the small enum, field, and loader tasks into one config implementation task, and merge the two shipped-config edits. Remove the extra dispatch-only test, which duplicates the policy behavior tests, and trim prescribed import ordering and similar mechanical details. This retains the required coverage while making the plan easier to execute.
